query: Consider the following context: High entropy alloys have excellent wear resistance, so they have great application prospects in the fields of wear resistance and surface protection. In that context, which material can be used for adhere to the surface of a Cu matrix, and why?

generation.hypothesis: A high-entropy alloy (HEA) coating can be used to adhere to the surface of a Cu matrix to improve wear resistance.
generation.structural_mediator: Formation of a single-phase (disordered) HEA solid solution
generation.mechanism: The HEA coating improves wear resistance by reducing material loss under medium and low load conditions, due to its high hardness and plasticity.
generation.predicted_outcome: Improved wear resistance of the Cu matrix
generation.baseline: Wear resistance of the Cu matrix without HEA coating
generation.boundary: The HEA coating must be properly adhered to the Cu matrix surface
generation.uncertainty: The optimal composition and processing conditions for the HEA coating are uncertain

falsification_experiment.design: Tribological testing of Cu matrix with and without HEA coating
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the wear rate of the Cu matrix with HEA coating is not significantly lower than that without HEA coating, the hypothesis is falsified.
